title: Barrow Field's flavor text ('Ivy chokes a loose-looking stone... the hunter west of the village would know how it moves') never resolves into an action even after visiting the hunter and getting exactly the promised info ('a gap under a fallen stone on the north face... it's in the tally by the rack').
